scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.share: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,tunnel -c blue,magenta "caffeinate -dims node server/index.js" "cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://localhost:3000"
